title: Machine learning-based design strategy for 3D printable bioink: elastic modulus and yield stress determine printability.
summary: Regression-derived formulations produced high-fidelity printed structures with viable proliferating cells. This is a materials/printing result, not demonstrated tissue therapy.
organization: Korea Institute of Science and Technology; Korea Institute of Machinery & Materials; Korea University of Science and Technology
